now.text: In episode 51, while Gyrich hides with Trask, Master Mold's Sentinels seize him, and he flees once the X-Men stop it.
cases: FX-001 The Master Mold Uprising (X-Men: The Animated Series)

changes.evidence: FX-001 The Master Mold Uprising is the episode 13 'The Final Decision' event (the app's case: Kelly carried to Master Mold, Xavier flies the Blackbird into it). This record is episode 51 'Courage', a later, separate incident in which Master Mold's surviving head has Gyrich and Trask seized; it is not that report (the matching Trask, Master Mold and Sentinels records for this episode carry no case).

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In episode 70, Arkon takes Storm to his world to be his bride, and the X-Men clash with him.

proposed.text: In episode 70, Arkon brings Storm to his world to calm its deadly storms, then asks her to marry him, and the X-Men clash with him.

changes.evidence: In 'Storm Front' Part I, Arkon comes to Earth and begs Storm to return with him to save his planet Polemachus from meteorological chaos; only after she succeeds does he ask her to marry him. He does not take her there to be his bride.
